title: Tim Dooley — Ordered Prediction & Foresight Master Index
status: canonical navigation layer; additive; does not replace specialist ledgers
purpose: Provide one ordered reader/machine index over explicit fulfilled predictions, implicit foresight, partial/open forecasts, revelation-form statements, legacy recovery claims, negative controls and specialist branches such as FAFO, Moloch/Farm/Josh precedence and under-mined domains.
counting_rule: Count unique forecast/candidate records once. A single compound statement may contain multiple independently testable components in the strict fulfilled master, but this index also exposes forecast clusters to avoid inflating independence.

headline_counts.note: Counts are navigation counts, not a statistical success denominator. FAFO adds a specialist research cluster but currently adds no strict fulfilled hit. The Moloch/Farm/Josh branch is classified as prior-symbolic pattern with named-entity precursor and also adds no strict fulfilled hit. The under-mined-domain audit expands recovery coverage without changing the strict fulfilled count. Native lolcow/Farm/Milk vocabulary is explicitly controlled for rather than counted as independent foresight.

strength_lanes.name: negative control
strength_lanes.definition: dated or remembered vision/prediction currently unfulfilled; retained to prevent success-only curation
